ops.title: Machine repair passes: yasyf box + yasyf-home (release-gated steps)
ops.description:
Both machines reachable as of 2026-07-25 evening (box woken via WoL; caffeinated 4h). Pre-repair sweep (debris check + serve kickstart, recipe step 1) dispatched separately.

**Gated on the A5 release wave** (fusekit v1.15.3, synckit, cc-patch, reposync, cc-notes, cc-pool releases containing the daemonkit v0.20.6 repin — in flight, workflow wf_ae6f61d6).

**yasyf box** — follow repair order v3 in note d0d443d0: (2) brew upgrade synckit/cc-pool/reposync to A5 baseline releases; (3) regenerate manifests via `reposync install` / `cc-pool sync enable` (ONLY after synckitd upgrade — note 6030458c ordering constraint); (4) `synckitd host add` state migration preserving peer yasyf@yasyf-home; (5) restart serve/reconcile/cookiesync, watch counters to zero; (6) hygiene: rm stray GOBIN synckitd + six swarm artifacts, brew cleanup old kegs. Leave the 12 swarm-era Claude sessions untouched (user reviews first). Do not delete codex rollout files or bookmark archives.

**yasyf-home** — upgrade synckitd/cc-pool/cc-notes via brew (synckitd BEFORE manifest regen), ensure cc-pool daemon provides sync.sock, then verify zero `acct-18 content catch-up: context deadline exceeded` over an observation window. No daemonkit/cc-patch footprint on this machine.

ops.text: yasyf box: synckit serve log handshake-failure delta = 0 over 30 min; reconcile running exit-0; manifests regenerated post-upgrade; peer yasyf@yasyf-home preserved in host registry
yasyf-home: zero acct-18 content catch-up errors over an observation window with mounts actively serving
both: fleet brew packages at the A5 baseline releases; no swarm debris processes; stray GOBIN synckitd removed (box)
